settings.heading: Wellness
settings.description: We recommend two wellness health checks per year to ensure your pet is in top shape. Whether you have a new puppy or kitten, an adult pet, or a senior companion, wellness checks help ensure your pet lives a long and happy life.

settings.heading: Dental Checks
settings.description: Your pet’s dental health plays a big role in their overall well-being. Routine dental checks help prevent plaque, gum disease, and tooth loss, while also avoiding potential complications that can affect the heart, kidneys, and other organs. A healthy mouth means a healthier, happier pet.

settings.heading: Parasite Prevention
settings.description: Parasites like fleas, ticks, and worms aren’t just an irritation—they can lead to serious health problems. A year-round parasite prevention plan protects your pet from discomfort, disease, and long-term harm, giving them the freedom to explore and enjoy life safely.

settings.heading: Don't just take our word for it...
Choose the right treat
settings.description: Select treats designed especially for puppies, made with high-quality, natural ingredients that support healthy growth, strong bones, and overall development. Look for soft textures that are gentle on young teeth.

settings.heading: Keep portions small
settings.description: Offer small, bite-sized pieces to avoid overfeeding and to ensure your puppy stays focused during training. Smaller portions are also easier for them to chew and digest.

settings.heading: Use treats for training
settings.description: Make treats a powerful training tool by using them for positive reinforcement. Reward your puppy immediately after desired behaviors so they can clearly connect the action with the reward, helping them learn faster.

settings.heading: Begin gradually
settings.description: Introduce treats slowly into your puppy’s diet. Start with single or limited-ingredient options to reduce the risk of upsetting their developing digestive system and to help identify any sensitivities or allergies early on.
